profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I am a passionate software engineer who loves to teach and learn.

Outside of my work I love to play sports, I'm a loyal (suffering) fan of the Toronto Maple Leafs, and I run two Youtube channels; one dedicated to teaching math and computer programming concepts and the other to hockey (both can be seen in my Projects).

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- C++ support for SIL testing of onboard charging systems for platforms: Semitruck, Cybertruck, Models S,X,3,Y
- C++ models of hardware subsystems: motorized door and latch, chargers
- C++ modeling of the communication between vehicle and charger (support for CAN and ethernet protocols)
- Embedded Software (C) for the charge port (bug fixes from field data and regression tests)
- built C++ API around National Instruments FPGA for HIL tester
positions.insights: Skills: C++ · C (Programming Language) · Python (Programming Language) · Linux

positions.title: Embedded Software Engineer & Intern Supervisor
positions.description:
- Architecture of a multi-threaded C++ application for firmware used in high-speed SerDes
- As the Intern Supervisor, I lead weekly meetings with Logic Design interns to give progress reports and assist them with their current work

positions.title: ASIC Logic Design Engineer
positions.description:
Digital circuit design in Verilog:
- designed a First In First Out (FIFO) queue collision monitor
- designed an Advanced Peripheral Bus (APB) arbiter
- designed a Least Mean Squares (LMS) adaptation algorithm for a digital Feed Forward Equalizer (FFE)

Modeling of analog circuits:
- behavioral models for a Continuous Time Linear Equalizer (CTLE), an analog to digital converter (ADC), assisted with the modeling of an analog Decision Feedback Equalizer (DFE)

Firmware development:
- wrote C and C++ programs to assist the Verification team with micro controller functionality
- created multi-threaded hardware management firmware on top of FreeRTOS

Scripting:
- shell automation of tasks (Python, Perl, Matlab and Bash)

Systems modeling:
- Used Matlab and Simulink to verify algorithms and system level architectures

Mentoring:
- led training sessions and was a mentor for the fundamentals of Serializer Deserializers (SerDes), transistor logic, Verilog/SystemVerilog, C++

positions.title: Undergraduate Teaching Assistant | ELEC 374 Digital Systems
positions.description: - Lab TA for ELEC374 Digital Systems Engineering. Taught and facilitated labs on designing a Reduced Instruction Set Computer (RISC)

positions.title: Undergraduate Teaching Assistant | ELEC 377 Operating Systems
positions.description: - Lab TA for ELEC377 Operating Systems. Taught and facilitated labs on the Linux Kernel and OS concepts

positions.title: Junior Head Hockey Counsellor
positions.description:
- In charge of planning and running weekly on ice drills
- Led other counsellors ensuring efficiency of operation
- Led off-ice training

positions.title: Hockey Instructor
positions.description:
- Taught hockey skills and game strategy
- Led on ice drills and dry-land training

volunteerExperiences.description: - Mentored and taught math to inner city elementary school children

projects.title: Youtube Channel - Mr Mouse Math
projects.description:
- Create explanatory math and computer programming videos
- Topics covered to date: Euler’s Identity/Formula, The Fourier Series explained with Linear Algebra, The Fourier Transform, The Fast Fourier Transform (with C++ code), Machine Learning, Cryptography (RSA & Elliptic Curves), Computer Graphics (3D Transformation Matrices, OpenGL pipeline)

projects.title: Youtube Channel - Mr Mouse
projects.description:
- Edit and sequence video clips on professional hockey using Adobe Premiere Pro and iMovie
- Generated over 2 million total views
